title: Pais inspired by Steven Greer documentaries

tellings.quote: it was a lot of things that were done by Dr. Steven Greer.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy engineer with patents for unusual flight technology, tells Michels that part of what inspired him was "a lot of things that were done by Dr. Steven Greer", a UFO activist. He means Greer's documentaries Close Encounters of the Fifth Kind and Unacknowledged, which would mean that films about UFOs helped shape a Navy scientist's work.
